channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.10'

about.description:
Use airflow to author workflows as directed acyclic graphs (DAGs)
of tasks. The airflow scheduler executes your tasks on an array of
workers while following the specified dependencies. Rich command
line utilities make performing complex surgeries on DAGs a snap.
The rich user interface makes it easy to visualize pipelines
running in production, monitor progress, and troubleshoot issues
when needed.

When workflows are defined as code, they become more maintainable,
versionable, testable, and collaborative.
about.summary:
Airflow is a platform to programmatically author, schedule and monitor
workflows

name: airflow
raw_meta_yaml:
# python must be less than this version
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: airflow
  pypi_name: apache-airflow
  version: "3.3.1"
  task_sdk_version: "1.3.1"  # manually update with each airflow release
  python_over: "3.15"

recipe:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ pypi_name[0] }}/${{ pypi_name }}/apache_airflow-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: a62ee9c46b7b8c919a46a88ee9346e0b36bc4ff10d6f9ac7cde5a6165da52164
    target_directory: airflow
  - url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/a/apache-airflow-core/apache_airflow_core-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 0c4ae4f3aea72dc2087b615305ea97ff0247b266bf6fa6661877ce1e1d9a951b
    target_directory: airflow-core
  - url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/a/apache-airflow-task-sdk/apache_airflow_task_sdk-${{ task_sdk_version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 21c1086c133ede94defde2b455541cadadf564f7e6d189d1af22c6ef186bb6e3
    target_directory: airflow-task-sdk

build:
  number: 0

outputs:
  - package:
      name: apache-airflow-task-sdk
      version: ${{ task_sdk_version }}
    build:
      noarch: python
      script:
        - cd "${SRC_DIR}/airflow-task-sdk"
        - $PYTHON -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - pip
        - hatchling ==1.30.1
        - packaging ==26.2
        - pathspec ==1.1.1
        - pluggy ==1.6.0
        # tightest of upstream's floors (python <3.11)
        - tomli ==2.4.1
        - trove-classifiers ==2026.6.1.19
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }},<${{ python_over }}
        - apache-airflow-core >=3.3.0,<3.4.0
        # tightest of upstream's floors (python >=3.14)
        - asgiref >=3.11.1
        - attrs >=24.2.0,!=25.2.0
        - babel >=2.17.0
        - fsspec >=2023.10.0
        - httpx >=0.27.0
        - jinja2 >=3.1.5
        - methodtools >=0.4.7
        - msgspec >=0.19.0
        - python-dateutil >=2.7.0
        - psutil >=6.1.0
        - structlog >=26.1.0
        - greenback >=1.2.1
        - tenacity >=8.3.0
        - pendulum >=3.1.0
        - colorlog >=6.8.2
        - pydantic >2.11.0
        - pygtrie >=2.5.0
        - packaging >=25.0
        - typing_extensions >=4.14.1
        - pluggy >=1.5.0
        # tightest of upstream's floors (python <3.12)
        - importlib_metadata >=6.5
        - pathspec >=0.9.0
        - jsonschema >=4.19.1
        - opentelemetry-api >=1.27.0
        - isoduration >=20.11.0
    # tests section intentionally omitted because of circular dependencies
    about:
      summary: Python Task SDK for Apache Airflow DAG Authors
      license: Apache-2.0
      license_file: airflow-task-sdk/LICENSE
      homepage: https://github.com/apache/airflow
      repository: https://github.com/apache/airflow
      documentation: https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/main/task-sdk/README.md
  - package:
      name: apache-airflow-core
    build:
      noarch: python
      python:
        entry_points:
          - airflow = airflow.__main__:main
      script:
        - cd "${SRC_DIR}/airflow-core"
        - $PYTHON -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - pip
        - gitdb ==4.0.12
        - gitpython ==3.1.50
        - hatchling ==1.30.1
        - packaging ==26.2
        - pathspec ==1.1.1
        - pluggy ==1.6.0
        - smmap ==5.0.3
        # tightest of upstream's floors (python <3.11)
        - tomli ==2.4.1
        - trove-classifiers ==2026.6.1.19
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }},<${{ python_over }}
        - a2wsgi >=1.10.8
        - cachetools >=6.0.0
        - aiosqlite >=0.20.0,!=0.22.0
        - alembic >=1.13.1,<2.0
        - argcomplete >=1.10
        # tightest of upstream's floors (python >=3.14)
        - asgiref >=3.11.1
        - attrs >=22.1.0,!=25.2.0
        - cadwyn >=6.1.1
        - colorlog >=6.8.2
        - cron-descriptor >=1.2.24
        - croniter >=6.2.2
        - cryptography >=44.0.3
        - deprecated >=1.2.13
        - dill >=0.2.2
        # fastapi[standard-no-fastapi-cloud-cli] needs nothing extra on conda-forge
        - fastapi >=0.129.0,<0.137.0
        - uvicorn >=0.37.0
        - starlette >=1.0.1
        - httpx >=0.25.0
        # tightest of upstream's floors (python >=3.12)
        - importlib_metadata >=7.0
        - itsdangerous >=2.0
        - jinja2 >=3.1.5
        - jsonschema >=4.19.1
        - lazy-object-proxy >=1.2.0
        # tightest of upstream's floors (python >=3.14)
        - libcst >=1.8.6
        - linkify-it-py >=2.0.0
        - lockfile >=0.12.2
        - methodtools >=0.4.7
        - natsort >=8.4.0
        - opentelemetry-api >=1.27.0
        - opentelemetry-exporter-otlp >=1.27.0
        - opentelemetry-proto >=1.27.0,<9999
        - packaging >=25.0
        - pathspec >=0.9.0
        - pendulum >=3.1.0
        - pluggy >=1.5.0
        - psutil >=5.8.0
        - pydantic >=2.11.0
        - pygments >=2.0.1,!=2.19.0
        - pyjwt >=2.11.0
        - python-daemon >=3.0.0
        - python-dateutil >=2.7.0
        - python-slugify >=5.0
        - requests >=2.32.0,<3
        - rich-argparse >=1.0.0
        - rich >=13.6.0
        - setproctitle >=1.3.3
        - sqlalchemy >=2.0.50
        # start sqlalchemy[asyncio]
        - greenlet !=0.4.17
        # end sqlalchemy[asyncio]
        - svcs >=25.1.0
        - tabulate >=0.9.0
        - tenacity >=8.3.0
        - termcolor >=3.0.0
        - typing_extensions >=4.14.1
        - universal-pathlib >=0.3.8
        - uuid6 >=2024.7.10
        - apache-airflow-task-sdk ==${{ task_sdk_version }}
        - apache-airflow-providers-common-compat >=1.7.4
        - apache-airflow-providers-common-io >=1.6.3
        - apache-airflow-providers-common-sql >=1.28.1
        - apache-airflow-providers-smtp >=2.3.1
        - apache-airflow-providers-standard >=1.9.0
        - msgspec >=0.19.0
        - pygtrie >=2.5.0
        - structlog >=26.1.0
        - pyyaml >=6.0.3
        - isoduration >=20.11.0
    # tests section intentionally omitted because of circular dependencies
    about:
      summary: Core packages for Apache Airflow, schedule and API server
      license: MIT AND BSD-3-Clause AND BSD-2-Clause AND Apache-2.0
      license_file:
        - airflow-core/LICENSE
        - airflow-core/NOTICE
      homepage: http://airflow.apache.org
      repository: https://github.com/apache/airflow
      documentation: http://pythonhosted.org/airflow/profiling.html
  - package:
      name: apache-airflow-core-with-all
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }},<${{ python_over }}

        # from the kerberos extra
        - pykerberos >=1.1.13
        - requests-kerberos >=0.14.0
        - thrift_sasl >=0.4.2

        # from the otel extra
        - opentelemetry-exporter-prometheus >=0.47b0

        # from the statsd extra
        - statsd >=3.3.0
        - apache-airflow-core == ${{ version }}
        - python-graphviz >=0.20
    # tests section intentionally omitted because of circular dependencies
    about:
      summary: Core packages for Apache Airflow, schedule and API server
      license: MIT AND BSD-3-Clause AND BSD-2-Clause AND Apache-2.0
      license_file:
        - airflow-core/LICENSE
        - airflow-core/NOTICE
      homepage: http://airflow.apache.org
      repository: https://github.com/apache/airflow
      documentation: http://pythonhosted.org/airflow/profiling.html
  - package:
      name: apache-airflow
    build:
      noarch: python
      script:
        - cd "${SRC_DIR}/airflow"
        - $PYTHON -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - pip
        - hatchling ==1.30.1
        - packaging ==26.2
        - pathspec ==1.1.1
        - pluggy ==1.6.0
        # tightest of upstream's floors (python <3.11)
        # for all python (not just py < 3.11) so we can stay noarch: python
        - tomli ==2.4.1
        - trove-classifiers ==2026.6.1.19
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }},<${{ python_over }}
        - apache-airflow-task-sdk ==${{ task_sdk_version }}
        - apache-airflow-core == ${{ version }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - airflow
          pip_check: true
          python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*
      - requirements:
          run:
            - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        script:
          - airflow --help
          - airflow db --help
          - airflow db check
  # alternative name for the package
  - package:
      name: airflow
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        # needed to make sure each python version gets a unique build string
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }},<${{ python_over }}
        - apache-airflow ==${{ version }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - airflow
            - airflow.sdk
          pip_check: true
          python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*
  - package:
      name: airflow-with-all-core
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }},<${{ python_over }}
        - apache-airflow-core-with-all
        - apache-airflow ==${{ version }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - airflow
          python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*
      - requirements:
          run:
            - python ${{ python_min }}.*
            - pip
        script:
          - pip check
  - package:
      name: airflow-with-all
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        # Some packages require pandas >=2.2.3 and others require older.

        # requiring the older pandas for now.

  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file:

    - airflow/NOTICE
  summary: |
    Airflow is a platform to programmatically author, schedule and monitor

    of tasks. The airflow scheduler executes your tasks on an array of
    workers while following the specified dependencies. Rich command
    line utilities make performing complex surgeries on DAGs a snap.
    The rich user interface makes it easy to visualize pipelines
    running in production, monitor progress, and troubleshoot issues
    when needed.

    When workflows are defined as code, they become more maintainable,
    versionable, testable, and collaborative.

  documentation: http://pythonhosted.org/airflow/profiling.html
